## 📝 Description

A clear and concise description of the new feature or improvement.

## 🛠 Technical Requirements

Detailed breakdown of what needs to be changed or added (e.g., changes to `ResumeData` types, new components, or metadata fields).

## 🛠 To-Do List (Tasks)

- [ ] Define JSON schema changes (if applicable)
- [ ] Implement UI components
- [ ] Update rendering logic (HTML + PDF)
- [ ] Add/update localization keys
- [ ] **Wiki Update**: Review and update relevant Wiki pages (e.g., `THEME_SYSTEM.md`, `STATE.md`, `CONVENTIONS.md`, etc.) to reflect changes.

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria (Requirements)

- [ ] Feature works as described in the description.
- [ ] Supports all 15 languages (translations added).
- [ ] Works correctly in both HTML and PDF previews.
- [ ] Passes all linter checks and build steps.
- [ ] Relevant Wiki documentation is updated.
